# Silken Reason

> Independent research lab studying intelligence in real-world systems.

Silken Reason studies distributed intelligence, decision systems, physical intelligence, memory and adaptation.

Veyra is the first product from Silken Reason Lab.

Veyra helps teams understand what changed, decide what to do, track what actually worked and reuse that history when a similar operational case appears again.

## Founder

Yue He is the founder and systems architect behind Silken Reason. Her work spans industrial IoT, telemetry pipelines, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure and Physical AI operations.
